display.purpose: The hero wordmark only; spans the viewport width, watch overlaps its lower half.

headline.purpose: Chapter headings. Footer invitation runs larger (clamp(2.75rem, 6.5vw, 6.5rem), -0.03em); exploded heading smaller (clamp(2rem, 3.6vw, 3.5rem), lh 1). 2.75rem on phones.

figure.purpose: Counted specification values with a lume unit beside them. 3.25rem left-aligned on phones.

title.purpose: Collection piece names and material tile names (clamp(1.25rem, 1.8vw, 1.75rem) in tiles).

part-name.purpose: Exploded-view labels, nav wordmark (1.375rem), footer wordmark (1.5rem), button text.

aside.purpose: Italic one-line closers and the subhead beside Materials, in bone-2 or bone-3.

body.purpose: Paragraphs under headlines, max 40 to 42ch, always bone-2.

body-small.purpose: Spec notes, piece descriptions, material captions; max 40 to 48ch.

nav.purpose: Uppercase nav links and CTA; the hero calibre line uses the same size at 0.06em without uppercase.

label.purpose: Uppercase definition terms (spec dt), the scroll cue and rail hint (lume, 0.12em). Never an eyebrow above a headline.

reference.purpose: Uppercase piece references (bone-3) and footer links (bone-2); legal line same size untracked.

shadows.name: watch-drop
shadows.purpose: Filter under the hero watch SVG.

shadows.name: lume-halo
shadows.purpose: Resting glow under the circular button.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Global :focus-visible treatment; the only outline in the system.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: CSS transitions: colour 0.3s, underline 0.45s, button/caption 0.5s, nav 0.6s, photo filter 0.8s.

motion.name: gsap-entrance
motion.purpose: One-time entrances: hero wordmark 1.6s, stage 2s, lines 1s; spec count-up 1.8s + 0.1s per row; spec row rise 1.1s. Never repeated.

motion.name: gsap-scrub
motion.purpose: All chapter choreography is bound to scroll position.

motion.name: gsap-release
motion.purpose: Magnetic button springing back on pointer leave.

motion.name: lenis
motion.purpose: Smooth scroll and anchor navigation; disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation-duration 0.001ms; transition-duration 0.001ms; scrub false; counts set instantly

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.note: Phone sheet is max-width: 899px. BREAKPOINT_DESKTOP = 900 in src/lib/motion.ts.

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Manufacture's Drawing"**

Meridian is one object seen in the dark. The page is a graphite-night ground on which a single watch, drawn entirely in layered SVG, is turned, taken apart, annotated and reassembled. Everything else on the page behaves like the engineering drawing around that object: hairline rules, pinned part labels with leader lines ending in a dot, tabular numerals that count themselves up, and a display Didone that reads like engraving rather than advertising. Density is low on purpose; chapters begin with roughly a viewport of air and nothing competes with the watch for light.

Light is rationed. Warm bone type on near-black carries almost every word; the one accent, lume phosphor, is spent only where a watch would actually glow: index plots and hand tips, leader-line nodes, unit abbreviations beside the live figures, the scroll cue, the nav's "Private viewing" link, and the single circular button at the end. Metals (brushed titanium, grey gold, blued steel) exist only inside the SVG watch and never leak into the UI chrome. The build confirms the direction contract's refusals: no split hero with copy beside product, no row of equal feature cards, no second accent.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite ground, warm bone type, one phosphor accent; metals live only in the drawn watch.
Bodoni Moda at optical size 96 for display, 48 for titles, 24 for labels; Hanken Grotesk with tabular numerals for everything that must be read.
1px hairline rules at 14% bone are the only structural lines; there are no boxes or borders around content.
Depth is ambient (soft drop shadows under the watch, a phosphor halo under the button); no hard or offset shadows anywhere.
Motion is scrub-bound to the scroll or runs as slow continuous mechanism; entrances use expo.out once and never repeat.

rules.name: The Lume Budget Rule
rules.body: Phosphor appears where a watch would glow and nowhere else: plots, tips, nodes, units, one cue, one CTA link, one button. If a new surface wants a second lume element in the same viewport, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Metals Stay in the Case Rule
rules.body: Titanium, gold and blued-steel values exist only inside `Watch.tsx` gradients. UI chrome is graphite, bone and lume only.

rules.name: The Fade-to-Ground Rule
rules.body: Content never ends with a hard edge against the page; it fades into Graphite Night via a vertical gradient (hero floor 28vh, nav scrim, material captions).

rules.name: The Optical Size Rule
rules.body: Every serif setting declares `font-variation-settings: 'opsz'` (96 / 48 / 24). Never let the serif render at its default optical size; the hairlines only work when the size is told.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Numbers are always tabular (`tnum` on body, `tabular-nums` on figures) so counted values and references do not shift width.

rules.name: The Labels Describe Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked labels exist only as definition terms, references, nav and cues. No headline carries an eyebrow or kicker above it; the build has none.

rules.name: The Light Not Edge Rule
rules.body: Elevation comes from light (glow, drop shadow, fade) never from edges (borders, outlines, hard offsets). The only outline is the 1.5px lume focus ring at 4px offset.

dos: **Do** set every serif with an explicit optical size (96 display and headlines, 48 titles and asides, 24 labels, wordmarks and button) and weight 400 only.
**Do** keep the one accent to where a watch glows: plots, tips, nodes, units, one cue, one CTA link, one button.
**Do** divide with 1px hairlines at 14% bone (`{colors.rule}`) and fade content into the ground with a graphite gradient rather than ending it on an edge.
**Do** bind chapter motion to the scroll (`scrub`, `ease: none`) and reserve `expo.out` for a single entrance per element; continuous motion is slow mechanism only (90s rotation, 60s sweep).
**Do** give the watch its 400/600 aspect box and a soft black drop shadow; keep the SVG crisp and never stretch or rasterise it.

**Do** provide the phone fallback that ships: one column, native snap rail, live caption instead of leader lines, automatic lamp instead of pointer tracking, and zero-duration animation under reduced motion.
donts: **Don't** introduce a second accent, a coloured UI surface, or use the watch's titanium, gold or blued-steel values outside `Watch.tsx`.
**Don't** add borders, outlines, card edges, or hard or offset shadows; elevation is light (glow, drop shadow, fade) or real perspective.
**Don't** put an eyebrow or kicker above a headline; uppercase tracked text is for definition terms, references, nav and cues only.
**Don't** repeat section entrances on re-scroll, or animate anything on a loop faster than the balance wheel except the 2.4s scroll cue.
**Don't** use a max-width container or equal-width card rows; chapters are asymmetric grids led by the object, inside the fluid gutter.
**Don't** build the hero as copy-left, product-right; the wordmark spans the width and the watch overlaps it.
